messages:
maria: Quick ask — we need an "ops-ready launch briefcase" one-pager for CISO/procurement review. Focus: security + SLAs + deploy modes (hosted/dedicated/private). Short slide for webinar + a 200-300 word benchmark narrative + clear inbound lead routing rules. Target: external-facing, but narrow, no fluff. Due EOD Fri.

alex: Got it. I'll draft the one-pager bullets. Can someone pull the recent SLA numbers and EU data residency note? :eyes:

sam: I have the SLA doc link: https://redwood.atl/sla-2026 (use section 2.1 for uptime/latency). For EU residency add: "data stored in region unless customer requests cross-region replication".

ryan: For the benchmark narrative, use the QPS and p50/p95 latencies from the microbenchmark we ran on v2 quantized models last month. Short headline: "<50ms p50, <350ms p95 for 2048 context on Dedicated." Keep it conservative.

anya: I'll own inbound routing copy and the decision tree for SDRs. Quick question — do we want separate webhook for "security interest" leads?

maria: Yes, please. Route security/regulatory intent to security-specialist SDRs + flag for solutions engineering. Ryan — can you give the exact metrics I can paste into the one-pager?

ryan: From the 2026-03 benchmark: Dedicated (4xA100): p50=42ms, p95=310ms, throughput 1200 tok/s; Hosted (auto) typical: p50=70ms, p95=480ms; Private on-prem (customer infra) — varies, include a note: "performance dependent on customer HW; Redwood Optimize recommendations available."

alex: Draft bullets for one-pager (putting in chat):
- "Why Redwood for secure inference": unified runtime across Hosted, Dedicated, Private; consistent API and rollout controls.
- "Security controls": VPC peering, KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs, SOC2-ready controls.
- "SLA & reliability": customizable SLOs for Dedicated, fallback routing, canary rollouts, 99.9%+ uptime options.
- "Cost/performance levers": batching, KV caching, quantization profiles via Redwood Optimize.

maria: Nice. Tone should be crisp, avoid too many platform buzzwords — aim for procurement language (controls, certifications, SLO numbers). Add a short legal blurb: "subject to contract".

anya: For inbound routing, proposing rules: (will export to Zendesk/HubSpot)
```
if lead.tags contains ["security","compliance","ciso"] then assign -> team:security-sdr, pipeline:enterprise-secure
else if lead.region == "EU" and lead.size > 1000 then assign -> team:field-eu
else assign -> team:plg-inbound
```
Also will add auto-email template for "security packet" with one-pager attached.

maria: Can we include a one-slide webinar blurb: 6-min benchmark + 6-min security + 6-min deployment patterns + 12-min AMA? Keep as 30-min session.

sam: I'll mock up slide deck — will reuse the microbenchmark chart and the deployment diagram (hosted <-> dedicated <-> private). Need logo-safe PNGs for infra diagram.

deploy-bot: docs/deploy-diagrams/secure-inference-diagram.png uploaded by sam at 1748003440

maria: Legal review needed on the "audit logs" and "KMS/HSM" claims. @anya please ping legal once draft is ready.

anya: Will do. Also prepping a 1-paragraph ops summary for solutions engineers (how to run a quick demo with Dedicated + fallback).

alex: For the benchmark narrative, draft headline: "Real-world secure inference: predictable latency under load" + 3 supporting bullets (workload, config, outcomes). I'll paste the 200-300 word draft into the doc later.

maria: Timeline:
- Wed AM: alex + ryan + sam first drafts in /marketing/briefs/ops-briefcase-draft.md
- Wed PM: internal review and legal check
- Thu AM: finalize one-pager + webinar slide deck
- Fri EOD: publish send to field + attach to inbound routing rules

ryan: Adding a short caution: don't promise exact p95 for Private deployments. Add phrase: "Private deployment performance varies by customer infrastructure; Redwood provides tuning guidance."

maria: Agreed. Anyone blocked?

sam: Need the microbenchmark CSV (I'll pull). Not blocked.

anya: I'll draft the HubSpot workflow and sample email.

maria: Great — thanks team. I'll create the doc and share the link in this thread when it's ready. :thumbsup:
